title: The Book Club Novel
transcript:
Man: So, did you finish the novel for book club? We're meeting Thursday.
Woman: I got about halfway. Mysteries aren't really my cup of tea.
Man: Really? I couldn't put it down. I stayed up till two finishing it.
Woman: I can tell. Maybe the second half's better.
Man: It gets much better once the detective shows up. That's all I'll say.
Woman: Good, no spoilers. Actually, could we pick something nonfiction next month?
Man: Bring a few suggestions on Thursday, and we'll vote.

questions.stem: Why does the woman say, "Mysteries aren't really my cup of tea"?
options: To suggest that the man read a different novel
To admit that she lost her copy of the book
To explain why she hasn't enjoyed the book much
To show that she prefers reading in the evening
questions.explanation: "Not my cup of tea" means something isn't to her taste, which explains why she's only halfway through.

options: That the club meet on a different day
That the woman skip to the last chapter
That they watch the film version instead
That the woman bring ideas for the next book
questions.explanation: He tells her to bring a few suggestions on Thursday so the group can vote.
